findings.problem: The trick says hombre sounds like "hum-bray", which teaches a pronounced h, but the Spanish h is silent (OM-breh), and the "hombre-ombre" part means nothing.
findings.fix: trick: HOMBRE sounds like "OM-bray": picture a man chanting a deep "om" as he walks into the room (the h is silent).

note: Hombre is also very common in speech as an interjection (\"¡Hombre!\"), but this card rightly teaches the noun meaning.
